source.title: Mark of the Spelunker Supreme — Item and Currency for (65)

quote: Bring it to Ab'xal or Ip'xal
notes: New Season 1 identity item 226206, independently corroborated by 2024-09-09 Wowhead news (https://www.wowhead.com/news/mark-of-the-spelunker-supreme-free-tier-piece-from-heroic-nerub-ar-palace-346460) and Warcraft Wiki (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Mark_of_the_Spelunker_Supreme). The token could be redeemed for one class-eligible Heroic Nerub'ar Palace tier piece, or a Normal tier piece with PvP ilvl bonus. Wowhead lists 65 possible currency-for items but exact individual output item IDs and class restrictions have not been extracted, so the reward list is explicitly incomplete, not an asserted full list. This was Season 1-only and can no longer be newly obtained per Warcraft Wiki; do not assume current merchant availability or disenchant eligibility. Numeric DE/milling/prospecting baseline casts and item histograms are unrelated and remain unknown.

rewards.name: One Heroic Nerub'ar Palace tier armor piece (chosen; exact item variant unresolved)

vendor: Ab'xal or Ip'xal, City of Threads, the Burrows, Azj-Kahet
